text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — we need to validate load/backpressure behavior for the new loadgen changes. Want a throughput + queueing profile for long-context paths (32k) and normal 2k. Can someone take a bench slot today? :eyes:
Jordan Li: I can run it at 15:00 PT on dedicated-gpu-3. What exact scenarios and flags do you want?
Maya Chen: Thanks. Three scenarios:
1) baseline short-context: max_tokens=2048, concurrency=200, run 10m
2) long-context stress: prefix=32k, max_tokens=256, concurrency=50, run 15m
3) kv-warmup then spike: warmup 5m with small batches then spike concurrency=400 for 2m
Use loadgen: `./tools/loadgen/run_bench.py --model redwood-13b-q5 --out=./out/<run>`
Add flags: `--histogram=queue_len --emit-batching-metrics --trace=perf`
Sam Ortiz: FYI dedicated-gpu-3 has the older kernel driver that was noisy last week. I'll pause the nightly collectors around your run.
Jordan Li: Copy. I'll also toggle --max-batch=8 to match prod slice.
Ben Gomez: Small note — set ENV MAX_SEQ=32768 for the long-context job, otherwise tokenization will truncate. Also set `TOKEN_SHARDING=on` for stable KV behavior.
Lucy Park: Pinging @eng-sre for a temporary quota bump on the dedicated pool (need extra 2 slots during spike).
eng-bench-bot: job scheduled: id=lb-20260325-77, node=dedicated-gpu-3, start=1804503600, owner=@Jordan Li
infra-bot: I created firewall exception for bench traffic range 10.11.0.0/24 — tags: bench, perf
Jordan Li: Starting scenario 1 now. Attaching initial stats in ~5m.
Jordan Li: (after run) scenario1: QPS=640, p95=172ms, tokens/s=260k, queue_len histogram: 0:68%,1:20%,2:8%,3+:4%
Maya Chen: Nice. Can you upload perf traces (perf.data) + batching-metrics JSON to the run folder and share link?
Jordan Li: Uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/lb-20260325-77/{perf.data,batching.json}. Giving read link: https://s3.redwood/internal/lb-20260325-77
Sam Ortiz: I restarted collectors. One caveat: saw a kernel-level pagefault spike during the long-context spike last time, might need to pin numa policy.
Ben Gomez: For analysis, please capture `procfs/shm` size too — we saw KV cache thrash on shm < 8G.
Maya Chen: Good call. Jordan, can you run scenario2 with NUMA_PIN=1 and SHM_MIN=8G? Also include `--profile-interval=10s` to get queue length time series.
Jordan Li: Will do. Estimated start in 20m.
Lucy Park: I'll review PR #4567 (export batching metrics) after lunch and leave comments; if it's green we can merge before the long run.
Jordan Li: Scenario2 started. Early: p95=520ms, QPS=120, queue_len histogram: 0:30%,1:35%,2:20%,3:10%,4+:5%
Maya Chen: That queue tilt looks expected, but can you capture the KV hit rate? If hit rate < 90% we should tune warmup length.
Jordan Li: KV hit rate during warmup ~96%, dropped to 82% during spike. Uploading full trace in 10m.
eng-bench-bot: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/lb-20260325-77/long-context/{perf.data,batching.json,kv_stats.json}
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. Action items: Jordan — final run with NUMA + SHM_min and max-batch=6, upload traces. Lucy — review PR #4567. Sam — monitor node kernel noise during spike. Ben — add shm check to the CI smoke. We'll reconvene tomorrow morning to decide config defaults for long-context path. :thumbsup:
